status: PROPOSED, NOT RELEASED. This file declares stage bindings and bookkeeping limits only; it authorizes no receiver call and no candidate execution.
interpretation_rules: A tie is inconclusive and does not evidence a resampling mechanism.
No significance-driven escalation and no futility claim from six draws per arm.

gating.rule: a root is a checkpoint iff analyze_diagnostic.public_status(diag, root) == "any_fail", i.e. any frozen public case status is wrong_value/format_error/interface_error/program_exception; timeout/unavailable/output_limit are "unknown" and are NOT checkpoints

limits_note: artifact_starts = 5 roots x 2 arms x 6 replicates; recheck_starts = 2 per root (reference + negative control). Read with study_adapter.load_grading_limits; this file is NOT a release manifest and is not on study_adapter.COMMITTED_RELEASE_MANIFESTS.
roots_order_note: assignment-table order from collect_diagnostic.assignments; ordering is scheduling only
